page.overview:
Who is Jessica?

Jessica is the one of the main protagonists of Together Forever, the third story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Jessica and Brittany are considered the prettiest girls in their class. Jessica has bright-red nails, shiny blonde hair, big blue eyes, high cheekbones, a pert nose, full lips, a perfect petite figure, and the most up-to-date fashions and makeup like lip gloss. For most of the story, she wears a tawny faux suede miniskirt that buttons up at the front, a cream-colored silk tank, and a pair of lace-up booties that match her skirt.

Jessica is shown to be extremely egotistical and have somewhat of a god complex. She believes that she is worthy of royalty status alongside her friend Brittany and viewing their boyfriends as trash that they can replace on a whim. She hates Cindy and Mindy simply because they don't cry or fall victim to her and Brittany's bullying, even willing to program Rosie Porkchop to injure them in retaliation.

Jessica and her friend Brittany were voted as Homecoming Queen and Princess at a school dance. The increased attention they subsequently received inflated their egos, believing themselves to be worthy of royalty. Jessica was also in a relationship with a man on the football team. Jessica dislikes a pair of girls named Cindy and Mindy.
